name: Vector Science and Therapeutics Corp.
summary: Vector Science and Therapeutics Corp. develops precision biomechanical devices and active transdermal delivery systems for musculoskeletal regeneration. The company offers cGMP-manufactured Rx peptides for physicians and patients across sports, regenerative, and longevity medicine channels. It also provides VectorMist, a commercial precision therapeutic platform, as well as Valor, a delivery system and transdermal platform. The company is based in Mequon, Wisconsin.
